secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing secret for the site-access gate session cookie (gate.server.ts). Required at boot.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role key for live data (historico/sync/valor-faturado stores). Without it, the dashboard shows built-in sample data.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Chave da API OpenAI (GPT-4o) para o auxilio IA que interpreta os dados de estoque na tela de boas-vindas. Obter em https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Sem ela, a intro usa mensagens estaticas.
